subject.title: [优化建议] install.sh 模块化拆分以提升可维护性

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor a modular architecture for `scripts/install.sh` now, or keep the public installer as one served script and accept only smaller targeted refactors?
rationale: This is not a broken current behavior; it changes a stable setup and publishing surface whose docs, tests, and website sync currently assume a single script.

options.title: Sponsor a guarded split
options.body: Approve an incremental module layout only if the served installer remains a safe single entrypoint and validation/docs/sync are updated in the same plan.

options.title: Limit to targeted refactors
options.body: Keep this as backlog context and extract or delete installer sections only when tied to concrete bugs or validation improvements.

options.title: Close as not planned
options.body: Decide that the curl-based installer should remain a single self-contained script to reduce helper-loading and publishing risk.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a guarded split
recommendation.body: Approve an incremental module layout only if the served installer remains a safe single entrypoint and validation/docs/sync are updated in the same plan.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent installer-specific history makes this the best available owner candidate for deciding whether the split shape is worth the compatibility cost.
